title: Stop Saying "I Want Revenge": 3 Better Ways #shorts
description:
Another word for revenge? When your neighbour takes your parking space, you don't just want revenge. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Get even: hurt someone back as much as they hurt you (informal)
• Pay someone back: punish someone for what they did
• Settle the score: get revenge for something in the past (idiom)

Would you get even, or let it go?

Clip: Big Business (1929)
